name: Ricardo Barbosa
bio:
Ricardo Barbosa's culinary journey began amidst the vibrant street food scene of São Paulo. He honed his skills at a prestigious culinary school before transitioning to corporate catering. His path into motorsport was accidental, catering a small event for a local racing team. He was immediately captivated by the energy and precision of the sport.

Ricardo is known for his uncompromising standards and dedication to providing top-quality meals, believing that a well-fed team performs better. He approaches catering with military precision, ensuring every detail is meticulously planned and executed. His blend of Brazilian flair and exacting standards makes him a unique asset to any motorsport team.

He is particularly insistent on using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients whenever possible, even when traveling internationally. This commitment to quality and sustainability is a hallmark of his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with a powerful presence and a warm, inviting smile, though he rarely smiles.

quirks: Insists on tasting every dish before it's served, even if he didn't prepare it.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Has a peculiar habit of polishing his silverware obsessively.
